document: Alone Against the Tide Solitaire Adventure by The Lakeshore (Call of Cthulhu MPRG 23174) (Nicholas Johnson, Lynne Hardy, Mike Mason etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You creep out of your cell as quietly as you can. You make it 
nearly halfway to the door before it turns out your best is not 
good enough.

Powell hurriedly rises to his feet and raises his gun at you. 
He has no intention of letting his prisoner escape. Your fight or 
flight response takes over, and you act solely on instinct when 
faced with your probable demise.
